FILTER(?t2_horsepower > ?aggregation_t23_horsepower_8 && ?t2_cylinders <= 3) .       {select (min( ?t23_horsepower) as ?aggregation_t23_horsepower_8 ) where { ?t23 a :cars_data . ?t23 :cars_data\#horsepower ?t23_horsepower .        }    } }

question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
original_sparql:
select distinct ?t1_id ?t1_maker where { ?t1 a :car_makers . ?t2 a :model_list . ?t2 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t1 .  ?t1 :car_makers\#id ?t1_id . ?t1 :car_makers\#maker ?t1_maker . ?t1 :car_makers\#id ?t1_id .
    ?t3 a :car_makers . ?t4 a :model_list . ?t4 :model_list\#ref-maker ?t3 .  ?t3 :car_makers\#id ?t3_id . ?t3 :car_makers\#maker ?t3_maker . ?t3 :car_makers\#id ?t3_id .      FILTER (?t1_id in (?t3_id)) . 
    FILTER (?t1_maker in (?t3_maker)) .    } group by ?t1_id ?t1_maker having(count(?t1_id)>=2 && (count(?t3_maker) > 3))

FILTER (?T1_artist_name in (?T2_artist_name)) .   ?T2 a :song . ?T2 :song\#artist_name ?T2_artist_name . ?T2 :song\#languages ?T2_languages .  FILTER(?T2_languages = 'english') .             }

question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 5 and have at least 2 friends.
original_sparql:
SELECT ?T1_name WHERE { 
    ?T1 a :highschooler . 
    ?T2 a :friend . 
    ?T2 :friend\#ref-student_id ?T1 .  
    ?T1 :highschooler\#name ?T1_name . 
    ?T1 :highschooler\#id ?T1_id .

question: Find the id of the pet owned by student whose last name is ‚ÄòSmith‚Äô.
original_sparql: select ?t1_petid where { ?t1 a :has_pet . ?t2 a :student . ?t1 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t2 .  ?t1 :has_pet\#petid ?t1_petid . ?t2 :student\#lname ?t2_lname . FILTER(?t2_lname = 'Smith') .        }

question: What is the id of the pet owned by the student whose last name is 'Smith'?
original_sparql: select ?t1_petid where { ?t1 a :has_pet . ?t2 a :student . ?t1 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t2 .  ?t1 :has_pet\#petid ?t1_petid . ?t2 :student\#lname ?t2_lname . FILTER(?t2_lname = 'Smith') .        }

question: Find the number of pets for each student who has any pet and student id.
original_sparql: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?t2_stuid where { ?t13 a :has_pet . ?t2 a :student . ?t13 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t2 .  ?t2 :student\#stuid ?t2_stuid .        } group by ?t2_stuid

question: For students who have pets , how many pets does each student have ? list their ids instead of names .
original_sparql: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?t2_stuid where { ?t13 a :has_pet . ?t2 a :student . ?t13 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t2 .  ?t2 :student\#stuid ?t2_stuid .        } group by ?t2_stuid

question: Find the first name and gender of student who have more than one pet.
original_sparql: select ?t1_fname ?t1_sex where { ?t1 a :student . ?t2 a :has_pet . ?t2 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t1 .  ?t1 :student\#fname ?t1_fname . ?t1 :student\#sex ?t1_sex . ?t1 :student\#stuid ?t1_stuid .        } group by ?t1_fname ?t1_sex   having(count( *)  > 1)

question: What is the first name and gender of the all the students who have more than one pet?
original_sparql: select ?t1_fname ?t1_sex where { ?t1 a :student . ?t2 a :has_pet . ?t2 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t1 .  ?t1 :student\#fname ?t1_fname . ?t1 :student\#sex ?t1_sex . ?t1 :student\#stuid ?t1_stuid .        } group by ?t1_fname ?t1_sex   having(count( *)  > 1)

question: Find the last name of the student who has a cat that is age 3.
original_sparql: select ?t1_lname where { ?t1 a :student . ?t2 a :has_pet . ?t2 :has_pet\#ref-stuid ?t1 .  ?t1 :student\#lname ?t1_lname . ?t1 :student\#stuid ?t1_stuid . ?t3 :pets\#pet_age ?t3_pet_age . ?t3 :pets\#pettype ?t3_pettype . ?t3 a :pets . ?t2 :has_pet\#ref-petid ?t3 .  ?t1 :student\#lname ?t1_lname . ?t1 :student\#stuid ?t1_stuid . ?t3 :pets\#pet_age ?t3_pet_age . ?t3 :pets\#pettype ?t3_pettype . FILTER(?t3_pet_age = 3 && ?t3_pettype = 'cat') .        }

question: What is the last name of the student who has a cat that is 3 years old?

FILTER(?t3_pet_age = 3 && ?t3_pettype = 'cat') .        }

question: What is maximum and minimum RAM size of phone produced by company named 'Nokia Corporation'?
original_sparql: SELECT (max( ?T1_ram_mib) as ?aggregation_T1_ram_mib_65 ) (min( ?T1_ram_mib) as ?aggregation_T1_ram_mib_20 ) WHERE { ?T1 a :chip_model . ?T2 a :phone . ?T2 :phone\#ref-chip_model ?T1 .  ?T1 :chip_model\#ram_mib ?T1_ram_mib . ?T1 :chip_model\#ram_mib ?T1_ram_mib . ?T2 :phone\#company_name ?T2_company_name . FILTER(?T2_company_name = 'Nokia Corporation') .        }

question: Find the Char cells, Pixels and Hardware colours for the screen of the phone whose hardware model name is 'LG-P760'.

question: List the name of the phone model launched in year 2002 and with the highest RAM size.

question: List the hardware model name for the phons that were produced by 'Nokia Corporation' but whose screen mode type is not Text.

question: List the phone hardware model and company name for the phones whose screen usage in kb is between 10 and 15.

question: Find the pixels of the screen modes that are used by both phones with full accreditation types and phones with Provisional accreditation types.
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_pixels WHERE { ?T1 a :screen_mode . ?T2 a :phone . ?T2 :phone\#ref-screen_mode ?T1 .  ?T1 :screen_mode\#pixels ?T1_pixels . ?T2 :phone\#accreditation_type ?T2_accreditation_type . FILTER(?T2_accreditation_type = 'Provisional') . FILTER (?T1_pixels in (?T3_pixels)) .   ?T3 a :screen_mode . ?T4 a :phone . ?T4 :phone\#ref-screen_mode ?T3 .  ?T3 :screen_mode\#pixels ?T3_pixels . ?T4 :phone\#accreditation_type ?T4_accreditation_type .  FILTER(?T4_accreditation_type = 'Full') .             }

question: Show the names of phones that are on market with number of shops greater than 50.

question: For each phone, show its names and total number of stocks.

question: Show the names of phones that have total number of stocks bigger than 2000, in descending order of the total number of stocks.

FILTER(?T2_product_name = 'cumin') .        }

question: Find the unit of measurement and product category code of product named 'chervil'.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_unit_of_measure ?T1_product_category_code WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_product_categories . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-product_category_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T1_unit_of_measure . ?T1 :ref_product_categories\#product_category_code ?T1_product_category_code . ?T2 :products\#product_name ?T2_product_name . FILTER(?T2_product_name = 'chervil') .        }

question: What are the unit of measure and category code for the 'chervil' product?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_unit_of_measure ?T1_product_category_code WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_product_categories . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-product_category_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T1_unit_of_measure . ?T1 :ref_product_categories\#product_category_code ?T1_product_category_code . ?T2 :products\#product_name ?T2_product_name . FILTER(?T2_product_name = 'chervil') .        }

question: Find the product names that are colored 'white' but do not have unit of measurement 'Handful'.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_product_name WHERE { ?T1 a :products . ?T2 a :ref_colors . ?T1 :products\#ref-color_code ?T2 .  ?T1 :products\#product_name ?T1_product_name . ?T2 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T2_color_description . ?T3 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T3_unit_of_measure . ?T3 a :ref_product_categories . ?T1 :products\#ref-product_category_code ?T3 .  ?T1 :products\#product_name ?T1_product_name . ?T2 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T2_color_description . ?T3 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T3_unit_of_measure . FILTER(?T2_color_description = 'white' && ?T3_unit_of_measure != 'Handful') .        }

question: What are the names of products that are not 'white' in color and are not measured by the unit 'Handful'?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_product_name WHERE { ?T1 a :products . ?T2 a :ref_colors . ?T1 :products\#ref-color_code ?T2 .  ?T1 :products\#product_name ?T1_product_name . ?T2 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T2_color_description . ?T3 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T3_unit_of_measure . ?T3 a :ref_product_categories . ?T1 :products\#ref-product_category_code ?T3 .  ?T1 :products\#product_name ?T1_product_name . ?T2 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T2_color_description . ?T3 :ref_product_categories\#unit_of_measure ?T3_unit_of_measure . FILTER(?T2_color_description = 'white' && ?T3_unit_of_measure != 'Handful') .        }

question: What is the description of the color for most products?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_color_description (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_colors . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-color_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T1_color_description .        } GROUP BY ?T1_color_description  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Return the color description that is most common across all products.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_color_description (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_colors . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-color_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T1_color_description .        } GROUP BY ?T1_color_description  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What is the description of the color used by least products?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_color_description (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_colors . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-color_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T1_color_description .        } GROUP BY ?T1_color_description  ORDER BY ASC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Give the color description that is least common across products.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_color_description (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :ref_colors . ?T2 a :products . ?T2 :products\#ref-color_code ?T1 .  ?T1 :ref_colors\#color_description ?T1_color_description .        } GROUP BY ?T1_color_description  ORDER BY ASC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What is the characteristic name used by most number of the products?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_characteristic_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :characteristics . ?T13 a :product_characteristics . ?T13 :product_characteristics\#ref-characteristic_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :characteristics\#characteristic_name ?T1_characteristic_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_characteristic_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Return the name of the characteristic that is most common across all products.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_characteristic_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :characteristics . ?T13 a :product_characteristics . ?T13 :product_characteristics\#ref-characteristic_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :characteristics\#characteristic_name ?T1_characteristic_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_characteristic_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What are characteristic names used at least twice across all products?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_characteristic_name WHERE { ?T1 a :characteristics . ?T13 a :product_characteristics . ?T13 :product_characteristics\#ref-characteristic_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :characteristics\#characteristic_name ?T1_characteristic_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_characteristic_name   HAVING(count( *)  >= 2)

question: Give the names of characteristics that are in two or more products?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_characteristic_name WHERE { ?T1 a :characteristics . ?T13 a :product_characteristics . ?T13 :product_characteristics\#ref-characteristic_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :characteristics\#characteristic_name ?T1_characteristic_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_characteristic_name   HAVING(count( *)  >= 2)

question: Find the names of the channels that are broadcast in the morning.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a :channel . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :channel\#name ?T1_name . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') .        }

question: Which channels are broadcast in the morning? Give me the channel names.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a :channel . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :channel\#name ?T1_name . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') .        }

question: what are the names of the channels that broadcast in both morning and night?
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a :channel . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :channel\#name ?T1_name . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') . FILTER (?T1_name in (?T3_name)) .   ?T3 a :channel . ?T4 a :broadcast . ?T4 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T3 .  ?T3 :channel\#name ?T3_name . ?T4 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T4_time_of_day .  FILTER(?T4_time_of_day = 'Night') .             }

question: Which channels broadcast both in the morning and at night? Give me the channel names.
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a :channel . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :channel\#name ?T1_name . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') . FILTER (?T1_name in (?T3_name)) .   ?T3 a :channel . ?T4 a :broadcast . ?T4 :broadcast\#ref-channel_id ?T3 .  ?T3 :channel\#name ?T3_name . ?T4 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T4_time_of_day .  FILTER(?T4_time_of_day = 'Night') .             }

question: find the program owners that have some programs in both morning and night time.
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_owner WHERE { ?T1 a :program . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :program\#owner ?T1_owner . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') . FILTER (?T1_owner in (?T3_owner)) .   ?T3 a :program . ?T4 a :broadcast . ?T4 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T3 .  ?T3 :program\#owner ?T3_owner . ?T4 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T4_time_of_day .  FILTER(?T4_time_of_day = 'Night') .             }

question: Who are the owners of the programs that broadcast both in the morning and at night?
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_owner WHERE { ?T1 a :program . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :program\#owner ?T1_owner . ?T2 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T2_time_of_day . FILTER(?T2_time_of_day = 'Morning') . FILTER (?T1_owner in (?T3_owner)) .   ?T3 a :program . ?T4 a :broadcast . ?T4 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T3 .  ?T3 :program\#owner ?T3_owner . ?T4 :broadcast\#time_of_day ?T4_time_of_day .  FILTER(?T4_time_of_day = 'Night') .             }

question: Find the name of the program that is broadcast most frequently.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :program . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :program\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Which program is broadcast most frequently? Give me the program name.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :program . ?T2 a :broadcast . ?T2 :broadcast\#ref-program_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :program\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: For each building, show the name of the building and the number of institutions in it.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :building . ?T2 a :institution . ?T2 :institution\#ref-building_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :building\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name

question: Show the names and heights of buildings with at least two institutions founded after 1880.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T1_height_feet WHERE { ?T1 a :building . ?T2 a :institution . ?T2 :institution\#ref-building_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :building\#name ?T1_name . ?T1 :building\#height_feet ?T1_height_feet . ?T2 :institution\#founded ?T2_founded . FILTER(?T2_founded > 1880) .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name ?T1_height_feet   HAVING(count( *)  >= 2)

question: Show institution names along with the number of proteins for each institution.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_institution (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :institution . ?T2 a :protein . ?T2 :protein\#ref-institution_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :institution\#institution ?T1_institution .        } GROUP BY ?T1_institution

question: How many proteins are associated with an institution founded after 1880 or an institution with type 'Private'?
original_sparql: SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :protein . ?T2 a :institution . ?T1 :protein\#ref-institution_id ?T2 .  ?T2 :institution\#founded ?T2_founded . ?T2 :institution\#type ?T2_type . FILTER(?T2_founded > 1880 || ?T2_type = 'Private') .        }

question: Show the protein name and the institution name.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_protein_name ?T2_institution WHERE { ?T1 a :protein . ?T2 a :institution . ?T1 :protein\#ref-institution_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :protein\#protein_name ?T1_protein_name . ?T2 :institution\#institution ?T2_institution .        }

question: How many proteins are associated with an institution in a building with at least 20 floors?
original_sparql: SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :institution . ?T2 a :protein . ?T2 :protein\#ref-institution_id ?T1 . ?T3 a :building . ?T3 :building\#building_id ?building_id . ?T1 :institution\#building_id ?building_id . ?T3 :building\#floors ?T3_floors .  FILTER(?T3_floors >= 20) .}

question: Show the name of track and the number of races in each track.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name

question: What are the names of different tracks, and how many races has each had?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name

question: Show the name of track with most number of races.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the track that has had the greatest number of races?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Show the name and date for each race and its track name.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T1_date ?T2_name WHERE { ?T1 a :race . ?T2 a :track . ?T1 :race\#ref-track_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :race\#name ?T1_name . ?T1 :race\#date ?T1_date . ?T2 :track\#name ?T2_name .        }

question: What are the names and dates of races, and the names of the tracks where they are held?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T1_date ?T2_name WHERE { ?T1 a :race . ?T2 a :track . ?T1 :race\#ref-track_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :race\#name ?T1_name . ?T1 :race\#date ?T1_date . ?T2 :track\#name ?T2_name .        }

question: Show the name and location of track with 1 race.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T1_location WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name . ?T1 :track\#location ?T1_location .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name ?T1_location   HAVING(count( *)  = 1)

question: What are the names and locations of tracks that have had exactly 1 race?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T1_location WHERE { ?T1 a :track . ?T2 a :race . ?T2 :race\#ref-track_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :track\#name ?T1_name . ?T1 :track\#location ?T1_location .        } GROUP BY ?T1_name ?T1_location   HAVING(count( *)  = 1)

question: Show the names of trains and locations of railways they are in.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name ?T2_location WHERE { ?T1 a :train . ?T2 a :railway . ?T1 :train\#ref-railway_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :train\#name ?T1_name . ?T2 :railway\#location ?T2_location .        }

question: Show the builder of railways associated with the trains named 'Andaman Exp'.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_builder WHERE { ?T1 a :railway . ?T2 a :train . ?T2 :train\#ref-railway_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :railway\#builder ?T1_builder . ?T2 :train\#name ?T2_name . FILTER(?T2_name = 'Andaman Exp') .        }

question: Show id and location of railways that are associated with more than one train.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_railway_id ?T2_location WHERE { ?T1 a :train . ?T2 a :railway . ?T1 :train\#ref-railway_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :train\#railway_id ?T1_railway_id . ?T2 :railway\#location ?T2_location .        } GROUP BY ?T1_railway_id ?T2_location   HAVING(count( *)  > 1)

question: Show the id and builder of the railway that are associated with the most trains.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_railway_id (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T2_builder WHERE { ?T1 a :train . ?T2 a :railway . ?T1 :train\#ref-railway_id ?T2 .  ?T1 :train\#railway_id ?T1_railway_id . ?T2 :railway\#builder ?T2_builder .        } GROUP BY ?T1_railway_id ?T2_builder  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Show the names of players and names of their coaches.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_player_name ?T2_coach_name WHERE { ?T1 a :player . ?T13 a :club . ?T1 :player\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#coach_name ?T2_coach_name . ?T2 a :coach . ?T2 :coach\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#coach_name ?T2_coach_name .        }

question: Show the names of players coached by the rank 1 coach.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_player_name WHERE { ?T1 a :player . ?T13 a :club . ?T1 :player\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#rank ?T2_rank . ?T2 a :coach . ?T2 :coach\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#rank ?T2_rank . question: Show the names and genders of players with a coach starting after 2011.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_player_name ?T1_gender WHERE { ?T1 a :player . ?T2 a :player_coach . ?T2 :player_coach\#ref-player_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T1 :player\#gender ?T1_gender . ?T2 :player_coach\#starting_year ?T2_starting_year . FILTER(?T2_starting_year > 2011) .        }

question: Show the names of players and names of their coaches in descending order of the votes of players.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_player_name ?T2_coach_name WHERE { ?T1 a :player . ?T13 a :club . ?T1 :player\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#coach_name ?T2_coach_name . ?T1 :player\#votes ?T1_votes . ?T2 a :coach . ?T2 :coach\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :player\#player_name ?T1_player_name . ?T2 :coach\#coach_name ?T2_coach_name . ?T1 :player\#votes ?T1_votes .        }  ORDER BY DESC (?T1_votes)

question: How many coaches does each club has? List the club id, name and the number of coaches.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_club_id ?T1_club_name (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :club . ?T2 a :coach . ?T2 :coach\#ref-club_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :club\#club_id ?T1_club_id . ?T1 :club\#club_name ?T1_club_name .        } GROUP BY ?T1_club_id ?T1_club_name

question: How many gold medals has the club with the most coaches won?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_club_id (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T1_gold WHERE { ?T1 a :match_result . ?T13 a :club . ?T1 :match_result\#ref-club_id ?T13 .  ?T1 :match_result\#club_id ?T1_club_id . ?T1 :match_result\#gold ?T1_gold .        } GROUP BY ?T1_club_id ?T1_gold  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Which city has the most addresses? List the city name, number of addresses, and city id.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_city (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T2_city_id WHERE { ?T1 a :city . ?T2 a :address . ?T2 :address\#ref-city_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :city\#city ?T1_city . ?T2 :address\#city_id ?T2_city_id .        } GROUP BY ?T1_city ?T2_city_id  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What are the city name, id, and number of addresses corresponding to the city with the most addressed?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_city (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T2_city_id WHERE { ?T1 a :city . ?T2 a :address . ?T2 :address\#ref-city_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :city\#city ?T1_city . ?T2 :address\#city_id ?T2_city_id .        } GROUP BY ?T1_city ?T2_city_id  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: Which film is rented at a fee of 0.99 and has less than 3 in the inventory? List the film title and id.
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_title ?T1_film_id WHERE { ?T1 a :film . ?T1 :film\#title ?T1_title . ?T1 :film\#film_id ?T1_film_id . ?T1 :film\#rental_rate ?T1_rental_rate . FILTER(?T1_rental_rate = 0.99) . FILTER (?T1_title in (?T2_title)) . FILTER (?T1_film_id in (?T2_film_id)) .   ?T2 a :film . ?T3 a :inventory . ?T3 :inventory\#ref-film_id ?T2 .  ?T2 :film\#title ?T2_title . ?T2 :film\#film_id ?T2_film_id .     GROUP BY ?T2_title ?T2_film_id   HAVING(count( *)  < 3)      }

question: What are the title and id of the film which has a rental rate of 0.99 and an inventory of below 3?
original_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?T1_title ?T1_film_id WHERE { ?T1 a :film . ?T1 :film\#title ?T1_title . ?T1 :film\#film_id ?T1_film_id . ?T1 :film\#rental_rate ?T1_rental_rate . FILTER(?T1_rental_rate = 0.99) . FILTER (?T1_title in (?T2_title)) . FILTER (?T1_film_id in (?T2_film_id)) .   ?T2 a :film . ?T3 a :inventory . ?T3 :inventory\#ref-film_id ?T2 .  ?T2 :film\#title ?T2_title . ?T2 :film\#film_id ?T2_film_id .     GROUP BY ?T2_title ?T2_film_id   HAVING(count( *)  < 3)      }

question: How many cities are in Australia?

question: Count the number of cities in Australia.
original_sparql: SELECT (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) WHERE { ?T1 a :city . ?T2 a :country . ?T1 :city\#ref-country_id ?T2 .  ?T2 :country\#country ?T2_country . FILTER(?T2_country = 'Australia') .        }

question: What are the countries that contain 3 or more cities?
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_country WHERE { ?T1 a :country . ?T2 a :city . ?T2 :city\#ref-country_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :country\#country ?T1_country .        } GROUP BY ?T1_country   HAVING(count( *)  >= 3)

question: Which film has the most number of actors or actresses? List the film name, film id and description.
original_sparql: SELECT ?T1_title (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T1_film_id ?T1_description WHERE { ?T1 a :film . ?T2 a :film_actor . ?T2 :film_actor\#ref-film_id ?T1 .  ?T1 :film\#title ?T1_title . ?T1 :film\#film_id ?T1_film_id . ?T1 :film\#description ?T1_description .        } GROUP BY ?T1_title ?T1_film_id ?T1_description  ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

question: What are the title, id, and description of the movie with the greatest number of actors?
